title: 羊飼いの男の子 (Hitsujikai no Otokonoko / The Shepherd Boy and the Wolf)
description: A shepherd boy repeatedly cries wolf to trick the villagers into running to help him. When a real wolf appears and he cries for help, nobody comes. A classic moral fable about the consequences of lying. One of the most recognizable Aesop's fables.
author: Aesop (adapted by NPO多言語多読)
